title: What Cuts a Gem
html:
The Dark Witch does not cut her gems. She eats them into shape with an acid she makes herself, and she has run out.

About

Given byDark Witch
Level21
LengthMedium
KindCombat skill unlocks
Quest points3

What you need

  • Caustic Gland ×10

Steps

  1. Talk to Dark Witch (inside Dark Witch Hut (around 1033, -42)) to get the quest.
  2. Kill 6 giant spiders east of the Dark Witch's hut (6)
  3. Go back to the Dark Witch inside Dark Witch Hut
    Bring 10 caustic glands from the Midland Cave stag beetles (10) - Caustic Gland inside Dark Witch Hut
  4. Kill the Etcher past the side door by the Midland Cave stag beetles inside Haunted Cavern
  5. Go back to the Dark Witch inside Dark Witch Hut

Some steps in between were not recorded.

Rewards

Reward
Gold1,000
Character XP45,000
Acid XP279
Quest points3
Choose oneScroll Caustic Blast
or Gem Emerald ×2
UnlocksAcid magic, Acid Bolt

What Dark Witch says

Dark Witch: Better. Now the part that matters.

Dark Witch: North of here there's a cave with a crossbones sign at the mouth. Just inside, on the first floor, you'll find stag beetles. They carry a gland under the jaw, full of the stuff I need.

Dark Witch: Don't bother throwing acid at them. They live in it. Kill them the way you already know how.

Dark Witch: These will do for the jar. They won't do for you.

Dark Witch: There's a side door by those beetles, and past it lives one the size of a cart. The tunnels back there are smooth because it made them smooth. I call it the Etcher.

Dark Witch: Kill it. That's the whole recipe. Come back when it's dead and I'll show you how to make it yourself.

Dark Witch: So the Etcher's gone. It was down there longer than I've been up here.

Dark Witch: Here is the whole secret. Acid doesn't hurt much when it lands. It makes everything that lands after it hurt more.

Dark Witch: Put it on something first, then hit it with whatever you like. Or let your friends do the hitting.

Dark Witch: Hold out your hand. Not that one. The one you don't mind losing.

Handing it in

"Mind where you point it."
